newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan, Vietnam deadlocked on Bach Ho term price.
newsitem.headline: Japan, Vietnam deadlocked on Bach Ho term price.

text.p: Term contract talks between Japanese lifters of Vietnam's Bach Ho crude oil and state-owned Petro Vietnam Trading Co (Petechim) are deadlocked, traders said on Wednesday.
The current price negotiations are for Bach Ho crude lifted between October to March.

In spite of buyers' requests to lower the price, Petechim has repeated its intention to roll-over the term price from the previous period, traders said. During April to September, Bach Ho was priced at a premium of 63 cents per barrel over a published price assessment of Indonesia's Minas crude.
The term price is on a free-on-board basis.
Japanese term buyers have yet to spell out to Petechim their ideal price levels, traders said.
Term buyers are due to reply to Petechim by the end of this week, they said.
The output of Bach Ho crude is around 135,000 bpd, about half of which is sold to Japan.
